rationale: Risk-management / position-sizing is explicitly named in the parent CIRV pre-freeze as a separate future application requiring its own freeze. This translation is frozen before any CIRV economic PnL is computed.

chronology.holdout_2025: LOCKED until both 2023 Discovery and 2024 independent replication pass all frozen gates

forecast_models.baseline: Exact parent plain HAR: logRV1/logRV5/logRV22; OLS; rolling previous 730 valid feature rows; min 500
forecast_models.challenger: Exact parent HAR-DOW: baseline + target-day Tue-Sun dummies; Monday base
forecast_models.realized_variance: sum squared 5m close-to-close log returns over UTC day; >=270 valid returns

economic_application.purpose: Test whether the already-validated HAR-DOW variance forecast improves an executable no-leverage volatility-targeting overlay versus the exact plain-HAR forecast.
economic_application.entry: first complete Binance Spot 5m bar open at 09:05 UTC
economic_application.target_volatility: sqrt(mean realized variance of previous 22 valid UTC days), computed using D-1 and earlier only
economic_application.portfolio: 50% capital sleeve BTCUSDT + 50% capital sleeve ETHUSDT; each sleeve multiplied by its own frozen exposure
economic_application.missing_data_rule: if required forecast or 09:05/23:55 execution bar is missing for an asset/day, that asset/day is unevaluable; no interpolation or later rescue entry
economic_application.capital_reallocation: none; unused sleeve exposure remains cash

costs.application: cost * deployed sleeve notional each evaluated day; flat-to-long entry plus long-to-flat exit

metrics: portfolio daily net return BASE and STRESS
HAR-DOW minus HAR daily net-return differential

gates.replication_2024: same gates as Discovery, on the untouched 2024 block
gates.holdout_2025: same gates as Discovery, one-shot only after Discovery+Replication PASS
gates.promotion_interpretation: Passing all three blocks can make the translation eligible for V3 Tier-2 economic review; it does not automatically promote or authorize live capital.

anti_hindsight: No alternate entry/exit time after outcomes.
No changing BASE/STRESS costs after outcomes.
No changing HAR/HAR-DOW model, rolling windows, weekday encoding or RV construction.
No using 2025 until both 2023 and 2024 gates pass.
No options, futures, trend filter, regime filter, threshold filter or alternative sizing rule as rescue.
